contents:
Grandma's chicken soup

1 whole chicken
3 carrots
2 celery stalks
1 onion
A handful of noodles
Salt, pepper, and a bay leaf

Simmer the chicken first. Add the vegetables after an hour. Noodles go in at the very end or they get mushy. Grandma never measured the pepper.

Chicken soup for cold days

- chicken thighs
- carrots and celery
- yellow onion
- egg noodles
- parsley

Cook low and slow. Taste before adding salt. Save two containers for the freezer.

Banana bread

3 very ripe bananas
1/3 cup melted butter
3/4 cup sugar
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla
1 tsp baking soda
Pinch of salt
1 1/2 cups flour

Bake at 350 for about 55 minutes. Check early because the new oven runs hot.

The banana bread everyone liked

Mash 3 bananas, then mix in melted butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla. Fold in flour, baking soda, and salt. Walnuts are optional. 350 degrees until a toothpick comes out clean.

Sunday sauce

Brown the sausage first. Add one diced onion and garlic. Two cans crushed tomatoes, one small can tomato paste, basil, oregano, and a little sugar. Simmer at least two hours. Do not let anyone turn the heat up.

Red sauce changes

Use less tomato paste next time. Add basil near the end. The spicy sausage was better than the mild one. Make garlic bread before everyone arrives.

Chocolate birthday cake

Buy candles and chocolate chips. Bake two round layers Friday night. Make frosting Saturday morning. Remember that Mia does not like coconut.

Cake checklist

[ ] eggs
[ ] cocoa powder
[ ] butter
[ ] powdered sugar
[ ] candles
[ ] strawberries

Pick up ice cream on the way home.

Weekend pancakes

1 1/2 cups flour
3 1/2 tsp baking powder
1 tbsp sugar
1 1/4 cups milk
1 egg
3 tbsp melted butter

Let the batter rest for ten minutes. Medium heat, not high.

Pancake reminder

Double the recipe when the kids visit. Blueberries go on after the batter is in the pan. Warm the syrup first.

Pasta salad for the reunion

Rotini, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives, feta, red onion, and Italian dressing. Make it the night before. Keep a small bowl without olives for Ben.

Picnic salad

Cook pasta but leave it a little firm. Rinse with cold water. Add chopped vegetables and dressing. Pack the cheese separately if it is going to be hot outside.

Holiday cookie list

- ginger snaps
- peanut butter blossoms
- shortbread
- sugar cookies for decorating

Need more parchment paper and two tins for the neighbors.

Cookie notes

Chill the sugar-cookie dough for at least one hour. Make the shortbread first because it keeps longest. Do not put peanut cookies in the blue tin.
